source_caption:
🎬 9-1-1: Nashville (2025–Present)

9-1-1: Nashville follows a courageous team of firefighters, paramedics, and emergency responders working in Nashville, Tennessee, as they face dangerous rescues, life-threatening emergencies, and the unpredictable challenges of protecting their community. At the center of the story is Captain Don Hart, a respected firefighter whose leadership and dedication have made him an important figure at his fire station. While responding to intense emergencies across Music City, Don must also navigate complicated family relationships, personal secrets, and unexpected conflicts that threaten the stability of his life. Alongside his fellow first responders, he encounters everything from devastating accidents and unusual rescue situations to emotional medical emergencies and high-pressure decisions where every second matters. As the team works together to save lives, their professional responsibilities become intertwined with personal struggles involving love, loyalty, ambition, and family expectations. Behind the excitement of Nashville’s music scene and vibrant culture, the firefighters discover that some of their greatest challenges happen outside the firehouse. Through dangerous missions, emotional confrontations, and moments of extraordinary bravery, they learn the importance of trust, teamwork, and sacrifice. Combining intense action, emotional drama, unexpected twists, and powerful rescue stories, the series explores courage, family, friendship, responsibility, and the dedication of those who risk their lives to protect others.

🎭 Genre: Action • Drama • Emergency Procedural

⭐ IMDb: Ratings may change as the series continues.

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Ryan Murphy, Tim Minear & Rashad Raisani

source_details.synopsis: 9-1-1: Nashville is an American procedural drama television series which premiered on ABC on October 9, 2025. It is the second spin-off of the 9-1-1 franchise, following 9-1-1: Lone Star, which concluded in February 2025. The series is created by Ryan Murphy, Tim Minear, and Rashad Raisani, with Brad Falchuk and Angela Bassett also serving as executive producers. In March 2026, the series was renewed for a second season which premiered on October 15, 2026.
